basic_details.job_title: AIIMS Jodhpur Project Research Scientist Recruitment 2026 – Walkin
basic_details.short_information: AIIMS Jodhpur will hold a walk-in interview on 03 December 2026; reporting starts at 09:00 AM and closes at 09:30 AM at Room No. 220, School of Public Health, 2nd Floor, Academic Block, AIIMS Jodhpur. Two Project Research Scientist-I posts (one Medical, one Non-Medical) are to be filled on a purely temporary basis under an ICMR-funded extramural research project, with pay of ₹67,000 + 20% HRA (Medical) and ₹56,000 + 20% HRA (Non-Medical) per month. The maximum age is 45 years as on the date of the walk-in interview.

age_limit.details: The maximum age for both posts is 45 years as on the date of the walk-in interview. Age concession to the extent of service rendered in other research projects may be admissible for experienced and skilled persons on a case-to-case basis. All educational, professional and technical qualifications should be from a recognized Board/University and full-time. The experience requirement should be experience acquired after obtaining the minimum educational qualification required for the post. | Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of each post.

post_wise_qualification.essential_qualification: Essential: First Class Post Graduate Degree, including the integrated PG Degree

qualification.details: Master's degree in Public Health or allied sciences with more than 2 years of experience in Non-Communicable Disease (NCD)-related projects. The experience requirement should be experience acquired after obtaining the minimum educational qualification required for the post. | Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of each post.

important_instructions: Both posts are purely temporary or contractual, co-terminus with the project; the tenure is six months, extendable based on satisfactory performance. Selected candidates will have no right to claim permanent employment under AIIMS Jodhpur or continuation of services in any other project; the contract service does not confer any right to further assignment or regular appointment in the institute. No additional allowance is admissible except HRA, wherever applicable. No TA/DA is admissible to appear in the interview. Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification. Candidates shall provide details of their previous engagement in ICMR-funded research projects; cumulative tenure will be governed by the latest applicable ICMR guidelines. The number of posts may increase or decrease depending on project requirements and availability of funds. The Competent Authority reserves the right to cancel, modify or postpone the recruitment process without assigning any reason. No enquiries shall be entertained in this regard after the due date.

content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Jodhpur Project
content_sections.text: The posts are in an Extramural Research Project funded by ICMR, titled "Generating evidence for lowering the screening age threshold in the NP-NCD program through Economic Evaluation and Decision Modelling of Mass and High-Risk Population-Based Screening (Mass-PBS and HR-PBS) of Youth (18–29 Years) in Rajasthan for Diabetes and Hypertension". The Principal Investigator is Dr. Manoj Kumar Gupta, Department of Community Medicine & Family Medicine, AIIMS Jodhpur.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: Master's degree in Public Health or allied sciences with more than 2 years of experience in Non-Communicable Disease (NCD)-related projects. Proficiency in Hindi, English, and the local language. Master's degree in Public Health or allied sciences with 2 years of experience in Non-Communicable Disease (NCD)-related projects. The maximum age for both posts is 45 years as on the date of the walk-in interview. Age concession to the extent of service rendered in other research projects may be admissible for experienced and skilled persons on a case-to-case basis. All educational, professional and technical qualifications should be from a recognized Board/University and full-time. The experience requirement should be experience acquired after obtaining the minimum educational qualification required for the post. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of each post.

rows.qualification: Essential: First Class Post Graduate Degree, including the integrated PG Degree

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Overall coordination, supervision, and management of research activities, ensuring adherence to the approved study protocol. Coordinate training programmes for doctors, project staff, and other stakeholders. Supervise record maintenance, data management, statistical analysis, report writing, and documentation. Manage project budgets, monitor expenditure, and perform other duties assigned by the Principal Investigator. Overall conduct, coordination & supervision of all research activities. Maintain project timeline, coordinate with PI/Co-I's, patient recruitment, implementation & training, data analysis, report writing.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: The filled application in the prescribed format ("Format for Application") and a Bio-data, submitted on the day of the walk-in interview. All relevant original documents. One set of self-attested photocopies of documents regarding age, qualifications and relevant experience. Essential qualification and experience certificates enclosed with the application form; otherwise the application is considered incomplete. A passport size photo (the application format has a space for it). A "No Objection Certificate" at the time of interview, for persons working in Govt. or Public Sector undertaking.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Reporting starts at 09:00 AM on 3 December 2026 and closes at 09:30 AM the same day; no additional candidates will be entertained for interview after that. A written examination will be conducted if a large number of eligible applications are received. Mere fulfilment of the essential qualification and experience does not confer any right to be called for the interview. Appointment will be subject to verification of original documents and medical fitness.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Both posts are purely temporary or contractual, co-terminus with the project; the tenure is six months, extendable based on satisfactory performance. Selected candidates will have no right to claim permanent employment under AIIMS Jodhpur or continuation of services in any other project; the contract service does not confer any right to further assignment or regular appointment in the institute. No additional allowance is admissible except HRA, wherever applicable. No TA/DA is admissible to appear in the interview. Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification. Candidates shall provide details of their previous engagement in ICMR-funded research projects; cumulative tenure will be governed by the latest applicable ICMR guidelines. The number of posts may increase or decrease depending on project requirements and availability of funds. The Competent Authority reserves the right to cancel, modify or postpone the recruitment process without assigning any reason. No enquiries shall be entertained in this regard after the due date.

faq.question: Q1. When is the AIIMS Jodhpur walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 03 December 2026. Reporting starts at 09:00 AM and closes at 09:30 AM, after which no additional candidates will be entertained.

faq.question: Q2. Where is the walk-in interview held?
faq.answer: It is held at Room No. 220, School of Public Health, 2nd Floor, Academic Block, AIIMS Jodhpur.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are there?
faq.answer: There are 2 posts: 1 Project Research Scientist-I (Medical) and 1 Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical).

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for the posts?
faq.answer: The Medical post needs MBBS/MVSc/BDS. The Non-Medical post needs a First Class Post Graduate Degree, including the integrated PG Degree.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The maximum age for both posts is 45 years as on the date of the walk-in interview. Age concession for service in other research projects may be admissible case by case.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for Project Research Scientist-I?
faq.answer: The Medical post pays ₹67,000 + 20% HRA = ₹80,400 per month. The Non-Medical post pays ₹56,000 + 20% HRA = ₹67,200 per month.

faq.question: Q7. Are allowances paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: No additional allowance is admissible except HRA, wherever applicable, and the emoluments are fixed as indicated against each post.

faq.question: Q8. Which documents should I bring?
faq.answer: Bring the filled application in the prescribed format, a Bio-data, all relevant originals and one set of self-attested photocopies of age, qualification and experience documents. Government or PSU employees must produce a No Objection Certificate.

faq.question: Q9. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Selection is by walk-in interview, and a written examination will be conducted if a large number of eligible applications are received. Appointment is subject to verification of original documents and medical fitness.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job, and is TA/DA paid?
faq.answer: No, the posts are purely temporary, co-terminus with the project, with a tenure of six months extendable on satisfactory performance. No TA/DA is admissible to appear in the interview.
